_doc: AppWorld instance (domains/appworld). Evolve set = the first 20 scenarios of AppWorld train (60 tasks), held-out = test_normal (168 tasks); S = fraction of trials with reward 1 (every unit test of the task passes) over 60 x k = 120 trials; C = policy tokens per trial. Policy: deepseek-v4-flash, thinking off, temperature 0 (frozen in domains/appworld/driver.py, which calls the endpoint with a stdlib client inside the AppWorld virtualenv); proposer / analyst / critic: deepseek-v4-pro, thinking off (rrsi/llm.py maps the upstream model names). Selection constants follow domains/tau2_retail/rrsi.json rescaled to 120 trials: beta1 = 0.25 / (1/120) (25% more tokens per additional solved trial), n_fail_traces / n_success_traces scaled by 60/74 tasks, w_s = 0 (inside the noise band only a token saving or a new structural component admits). delta = null: estimate it with calibrate from repeated base evaluations. concurrency = episodes in parallel per evaluation (each episode is its own process of about 0.7 GB, because AppWorld allows one open world per process); eval_parallel candidates are evaluated at once. heldout_k / heldout_k_endpoints: trials per held-out task for every candidate and incumbent / for the base and final incumbent (verify/, experiment E1).
